title: plantago tomentosa subsp. hypolasia
intro: Plantago tomentosa subsp. hypolasia, commonly known as Woolly Plantain, is a plant species within the Plantaginaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions attributed to this plant include the modulation of immune responses, anti-inflammatory and anti-edematous effects, and the inhibition of microbial growth. The bioactive constituents of Plantago tomentosa subsp. hypolasia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
